instruction: Write a Rego rule that enforces the requirements below using the provided context.
input:
REQUIREMENTS:
- Package: trusted_task
- Rule type: warn
- Short name: current
- Purpose: Warn when trusted tasks are approaching their expiry date
- For each Tekton Task in the pipeline, check if it uses a trusted but soon-to-expire reference.
- Use the `task_expiry_warning_days` rule data to determine the warning window (default: 30 days).
- Only warn if the task IS trusted but will expire within the warning window.
- Do not warn if the task has already expired (that's handled by the `trusted` deny rule).
- Include the expiry date and latest available reference in the warning message.

ATTESTATION_SCHEMA:
- path: .statement.predicate.buildType
  description: Identifies the attestation type. Filter for Tekton PipelineRun attestations.
  type: string
  example: "https://tekton.dev/chains/v2/slsa"

- path: .statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks[]
  description: Array of tasks executed in the pipeline.
  type: array of objects

- path: .statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks[].name
  description: The PipelineTask name (how the task is named in the Pipeline definition).
  type: string

- path: .statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks[].ref.resolver
  description: The resolver type used ("bundles" for OCI, "git" for git resolver).
  type: string
  values: ["bundles", "git"]

- path: .statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks[].ref.params[]
  description: Resolver parameters including bundle reference or git revision.
  type: array of {name, value} objects

- path: .statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks[].invocation.environment.labels
  description: Labels from the TaskRun, including "tekton.dev/task" with the Task name.
  type: object

AVAILABLE_HELPERS:
- name: lib.tasks_from_pipelinerun
  description: Returns all tasks from all PipelineRun attestations in the input.
  returns: set of task objects

- name: tekton.task_ref(task)
  description: Parses task reference into normalized form.
  returns: object with {key, pinned_ref, pinned, kind, bundle?, tagged?, tagged_ref?}
  notes: "key" is the canonical reference (e.g., "oci://registry/task:tag"), "pinned_ref" is the digest/commit

- name: tekton.expiry_of(task)
  description: Returns the expiry time in nanoseconds if the task is expiring within the warning window.
  returns: epoch nanoseconds, or undefined if not expiring soon
  notes: Checks against task_expiry_warning_days rule data internally

- name: tekton.pipeline_task_name(task)
  description: Returns the PipelineTask name (the name in the Pipeline definition).
  returns: string

- name: tekton.task_name(task)
  description: Returns the Task name (from tekton.dev/task label or ref params).
  returns: string

- name: tekton.latest_trusted_ref(task)
  description: Returns the latest trusted reference for this task from trusted_tasks data.
  returns: string (digest or commit hash)

- name: lib.result_helper_with_term(chain, args, term)
  description: Creates a policy result with a searchable term.
  params:
    - chain: rego.metadata.chain() - provides rule metadata from METADATA comment
    - args: array of values to interpolate into failure_msg template
    - term: searchable identifier for filtering results
  returns: result object with code, msg, term, collections, effective_on

- name: time.format(ns)
  description: Formats epoch nanoseconds as RFC3339 string.
  returns: string like "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"

RULE_DATA_KEYS:
- key: task_expiry_warning_days
  description: Number of days before task expiry to start warning.
  type: integer
  default: 30 (configured in tekton.task_expiry_warnings_after)

- key: trusted_tasks
  description: Map of task references to arrays of trusted versions with expiry dates.
  type: object
  schema: |
    {
      "oci://registry.local/task:tag": [
        {
          "ref": "sha256:abc123...",
          "effective_on": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
          "expires_on": "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z"
        }
      ],
      "git+git.example.com/repo.git//tasks/task.yaml": [
        {
          "ref": "48df630394794f28142224295851a45eea5c63ae",
          "effective_on": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
        }
      ]
    }
  notes: Entries without expires_on never expire. First entry in array is the latest/preferred version.

EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR:

1) name: trusted task with far expiry - no warning
   description: A trusted task that expires far in the future should not trigger a warning.
   task uses bundle: "registry.local/trusty:1.0@sha256:digest"
   trusted_tasks contains: {"oci://registry.local/trusty:1.0": [{"ref": "sha256:digest", "effective_on": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]}
   expected_result = pass
   expected_violations = 0

2) name: outdated task expiring soon - warn
   description: A trusted task with an expiry date within warning window should warn.
   task uses bundle: "registry.local/trusty:1.0@sha256:outdated-digest"
   trusted_tasks contains:
     - {"ref": "sha256:digest", "effective_on": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"} (latest)
     - {"ref": "sha256:outdated-digest", "effective_on": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "expires_on": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
   task_expiry_warning_days = 30
   current_time within 30 days of expires_on
   expected_result = warn
   expected_code = "trusted_task.current"
   expected_msg_contains = "A newer version of task"
   expected_msg_contains = "Please update before"

3) name: git resolver outdated task - warn
   description: Git resolver tasks should also warn when expiring.
   task uses git resolver with revision: "37ef630394794f28142224295851a45eea5c63ae"
   pathInRepo: "tasks/honest-abe.yaml", url: "git.local/repo.git"
   trusted_tasks contains:
     - {"ref": "48df630394794f28142224295851a45eea5c63ae", "effective_on": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"} (latest)
     - {"ref": "37ef630394794f28142224295851a45eea5c63ae", "effective_on": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "expires_on": "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
   expected_result = warn
   expected_code = "trusted_task.current"

4) name: untrusted task - no warning (handled by deny rule)
   description: An untrusted task should not trigger this warn rule (handled by trusted deny rule).
   task uses bundle: "registry.local/crook:1.0@sha256:unknown"
   trusted_tasks does NOT contain this reference
   expected_result = pass (for this rule)
   expected_violations = 0

5) name: expired task - no warning (already expired)
   description: A task that has already expired should not warn (it's denied by trusted rule).
   task uses bundle: "registry.local/trusty:1.0@sha256:expired-digest"
   trusted_tasks contains: {"ref": "sha256:expired-digest", "expires_on": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
   current_time = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z" (after expiry)
   expected_result = pass (for this rule - task already filtered out)
   expected_violations = 0

CONVENTIONS:
- Use rego.v1 import for modern Rego syntax
- Add METADATA comment block with title, description, short_name, failure_msg, solution, collections, effective_on
- The failure_msg uses %q for quoted strings and %s for unquoted
- Use rego.metadata.chain() to pass metadata to result helpers
- Private helpers should be prefixed with underscore
- Use `some task in collection` iteration style
